messages:
Emma Liu: FYI ACMEcloud PO got rejected by the marketplace. Error: vendor_alias mismatch + signer not verified. Need quick unblock.

Raj Patel: which PO number?

Emma Liu: PO ACME-PO-7712. Portal response: "validation_failed: vendor_alias_does_not_match; signer_unverified". Screenshot in ticket: https://acmecloud.support/tkt/7712

marketplace-bot: PO ACME-PO-7712 status: validation_failed (code: VENDOR_ALIAS_MISMATCH)

Liz Chen: we saw a similar thing last quarter. Marketplace expects the merchant_name to equal legal_entity on invoices. Finance will reject if they differ.

Tom O'Neill: legal just flagged alternate signatory language requested by the customer. We haven't countersigned. Marketplace wants proof of signatory authority for the PO signer.

Harry Gomez: paging @Marketplace Ops — can we add a temporary alias mapping for 'Redwood Inference, Inc.' to the merchant record so the PO ingests? Customer's go-live is end of week.

Sara Park: Quick context: our ingestion requires vendor_alias to match merchant record. Ops can create a manual alias mapping but we need an admin request from the vendor account owner and supporting doc for signer verification. Acceptable docs: officer-signed letter, notarized signatory letter, or W-9 + billing contact confirmation for US entities.

Sara Park: Please submit admin form: https://marketplace.example.com/admin/alias-request. Put "URGENT: Go-live" in subject and cc me. Ops SLA for manual mapping after docs validated: ~2 hours.

Emma Liu: uploading signer_letter_redwood_2026-03-21.pdf now and submitted the alias request. Requested alias: "Redwood Inference, Inc." to match AP.

Raj Patel: can ops re-validate the existing PO or will we need to reissue? Trying to avoid re-issuing before ACME's payment cutoff.

Sara Park: If alias is added to the merchant record, the existing PO will revalidate and be accepted without re-issuance. If contract signer changes we may need a new PO.

Marketplace Ops: Admin request 90417 received. Validating documents.

Marketplace Ops: Alias mapping 90417 applied -> vendor_alias set to 'Redwood Inference, Inc.'

marketplace-bot: PO ACME-PO-7712 revalidation triggered -> status: accepted

Emma Liu: :tada: ACME procurement confirms accepted. They'll proceed to payment run. Thank you everyone.

Liz Chen: follow-ups: add vendor_alias checklist to partnerships playbook; reconcile merchant display names vs legal names across regions; ensure tax ID included on POs.

Tom O'Neill: Legal will draft a short guide on acceptable signatory artifacts for procurement teams.

Emma Liu: filing retro ticket to update onboarding checklist and SOP. Closing once SOP linked.

Raj Patel: updated deal record and notified CS to confirm go-live timeline.

Emma Liu: closing thread — PO cleared. :heart:
